name: S2-COMPRESSED-ACT row 3 fixture: one Emerald Hill section beside one Chemical Plant section
note: Two DIFFERENT zones on purpose. Both donor tilesets start their tile indices at 0 and both use the low indices heavily, so a bake that loses the per-cell tileset key renders one clip in the other's art; a fixture made of two clips of the SAME zone could not tell those apart. The two clips are also the same section-index of their zones, so nothing about the answer comes from one being a bigger crop than the other.
